prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In to Sync & Secure Your Companion", "Choose your account method to ensure your pet data, personality traits, and custom creations are safely backed up.", "Select Account Sync Method", "Cloud Pet Recovery Enabled"]
1: ["Upload Photo & Select Rendering Style", "Pick your photo and select a visual art style to ensure your companion renders accurately on desktop.", "Choose Companion Source Photo", "Select Rendering Art Style"]
2: ["Official Pet Adoption Agreement", "Review your companion details and confirm adoption to start bringing your desktop pet to life.", "Confirmed Traits & Behaviors"]
3: ["Quick Guide: Interacting With Your Desktop Pet", "Right-click your pet on desktop to access settings, minimize to system tray, or open the chat console.", "Right-click anytime to hide or awaken your pet.", "Got It, Launch Desktop Pet"]
4: ["Your Desktop Companion is Live!", "Your pet is active on your screen. Here is how to access shortcuts and personalize your experience.", "Desktop Status: Active on Taskbar", "Enter Desktop Mode"]
5: ["Having trouble connecting? Try an alternative web auth link or temporary offline profile creation."]
6: ["Name Your New Pet"]
7: ["Generating Your Desktop Companion", "We are synthesizing your pet's animations and desktop interactions."]
8: ["Feel free to use other apps. We'll play a gentle sound when your companion is ready on your desktop."]
9: ["Choose Your Pet Companion Type", "Select whether you want a quick ready-to-play pet or a fully customized companion. You can customize anytime later."]

verdicts.problem: Suggests getting around the required sign-in step
